title: Neutral late-year versus central aggregate revenue loss

claims.text: The neutral late-year sensitivity variant yields a slightly smaller mean aggregate revenue loss than the central scenario; this reflects scenario construction assumptions, not causal attribution, and the two alternatives do not bracket a calibrated credible interval.

limitations: Assessment is for inspection only; historical input provenance is incomplete and the bundle is not recomputable.
Sensitivity alternatives are not assigned occurrence probabilities and do not define a credible interval.
Mean revenue loss is a signed estimate (neutral minus event revenue), distinct from the positive-part shortfall used for tail measures; gains are retained in the signed mean.
Scope is agriculture, forestry and fishing value added with conditional government revenue transmission; this is not a total-economy loss and not a sovereign default probability.
Causal identification is not established; differences between scenarios reflect model assumptions.
